subject: Game Theory
title: English Auctions
description: A quick win: understand English Auctions.

hook.text: The English auction is the one you picture: an auctioneer calls rising bids until only one bidder remains.

buildup.text: It's an ascending-price format. Each new bid must top the last. Drop out when the price exceeds your limit.

discovery.text: The winner pays just above the second-highest bidder's value. Competition sets the final price.

twist.text: Because bids are public, bidders learn from each other. This makes strategy transparent but predictable.

climax.text: English auctions dominate art, antiques, and real estate because the drama itself attracts bidders.

punchline.text: Going once, going twice—sold to strategy.

quiz.question: How does the price move in an English auction?
